description: Show the lines in the user's cart with qty, size, fabric and subtotal. It is the same server-side cart the human sees at allover.art/cart when signed in, so items they added in the browser appear here too. Use it to get the zero-based line index that update_cart_item takes — re-read after removing a line, since later indexes shift. Prices are as added; for the payable total with fresh prices, promo and shipping use get_order_preview. Read-only.
name: view_cart

checkout_url.description: Cart page URL for the human.

error.description: Present instead of a cart when the call failed (bad index, unavailable size, ...).

items.description: Cart lines in index order — this index is what update_cart_item takes.

custom.description: True when the line is a user-generated custom print.

subtotal.description: Sum of price x qty over all lines, USD.

title: View cart
